# ImageHandleAdornment

- Inherits [`HandleAdornment`](handleadornment.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ImageHandleAdornment")`

An image drawn on a part, facing along its `CFrame`'s look direction: a sign, an icon or a decal that shows through walls.

listed on the page of the class that declares them.
